description: This PHP source file defines the class AOPAssignManager, which manages assignment strategies for cases within the SuiteCRM platform, including distribution methods like round robin, random, least busy, and single user. It includes methods for retrieving user lists, handling configuration options, and maintaining the state for assignment logic.

classes.name: AOPAssignManager
classes.description: Manages assignment logic for cases, including distribution strategies such as single user, round robin, least busy, and random, with support for security groups and role-based distributions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the assignment manager with optional inbound email context, loads configuration, and determines the distribution method.

methods.name: isAOPFallback
methods.description: Checks if the current distribution method is a fallback default.

methods.name: getDistributionOptions
methods.description: Retrieves distribution options based on current configuration and fallback status.

methods.name: getRoleUsers
methods.description: Fetches users linked to a specific role ID.

methods.name: getAssignableUsers
methods.description: Determines the list of users available for assignment based on the distribution method and options.

methods.name: getSingleUser
methods.description: Returns the user ID designated for single-user distribution.

methods.name: getLeastBusyCounts
methods.description: Calculates the number of cases assigned to each user to identify least busy users.

methods.name: getLeastBusyUser
methods.description: Identifies the user with the fewest assigned cases.

methods.name: updateLeastBusy
methods.description: Updates the count of cases assigned to a user.

methods.name: getRandomUser
methods.description: Selects a user at random from the assignable users.

methods.name: getNextAssignedUser
methods.description: Determines the next user to assign based on the selected distribution method.

methods.name: getRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Selects the next user in round robin sequence, maintaining session state.

methods.name: setLastRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Records the last user in round robin sequence to persistent cache.
